description: Source code for a wizard in Odoo (OpenERP) that facilitates creating a partner from a CRM lead, including form definitions, validation, and order creation logic.

classes.name: make_partner
classes.description: Wizard class for creating a partner from a CRM lead, handling form display, validation, and order creation.

methods.name: _selectPartner

methods.name: _makeOrder
methods.description: Creates a new partner and contact, updates the CRM case, and returns an action to display the new partner.
